summary: Decodes a packed 4-bit (nibble) byte stream into float RGBA quads. Computes a source byte pointer from the object's data base (this+0x18), a stride for parameter a2 (this+0x1050) and a stride for parameter a3 (this+0x1054), iterates this+0x1058 source bytes, and for each byte writes the low nibble to the RGB channels (a4[0..2]) and the high nibble to the alpha channel, each scaled by 0.06666667. When the flag at this+0x10 is non-zero it calls ContactManifoldCleanup (0x00507845) on the decoded output buffer.

local_names.a3: second grid index parameter multiplied against the stride at this+0x1054
local_names.a4: output float pointer advanced by four floats per decoded byte

Iterate exactly this[1046] (this+0x1058) source bytes; the loop end pointer i is the source base plus this+0x1058 and the running pointer consumes one byte per pass.

Decode the low nibble of the current byte (*v5 & 0xF), scale it by 0.06666667 and write it to the RGB channels of the output quad (a4[0], a4[1], a4[2]); the 0.06666667 scale corresponds to the global float read flt_5AC108 (0x005AC108).
Capture the high nibble of the current byte (v8 = *v5 >> 4) and advance the source pointer; the high nibble is deferred to the alpha channel write of the loop increment.
Loop increment writes the alpha channel of the current quad as the scaled high nibble (*(a4 - 1) = v8 * 0.06666667) and the output pointer advances by four floats.
Guard on this[4] (this+0x10): when non-zero the decoded output is post-processed, otherwise the post-processing call is skipped.
Call ContactManifoldCleanup (0x00507845) with this cast to int and a pointer to the first decoded output quad (a4 - 4 * this[1046]) when the post-process flag at this+0x10 is set.
Function 0x0050A067 returns void after the optional ContactManifoldCleanup pass.
